text:
Batteries | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 which must be performed on a 
weekly bases as indicated 
by W1 in the title block.
Units (1&2) use battery mfg: NIFE, Unit (3): 
VARTA, Unit (4): SAFT
The first draft is initiated by 
electrical maintenance manger eng. Mohammed Abdel Moneim, tested by eng. Yasser 
Abdo, accepted by eng. Sayed Farag: general director, revised by EDEPC 
inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader El-Nagar, approved by eng. Mokhtar Abd El-Latif 
Mady head sector of Ataka PS .
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control's general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required
Disconnect the power supply fuse.
No 
 smoking is permitted in battery room.
Use standard personal safety equipment as helmet, safety shoes, safety goggles, and 
 rubber gloves and rubber apron.
Use 
 the proper insulated tools.
Disconnect the power supply fuse.
Don't place any tools on top of the battery cells.
Tools and Equipment
Hydrometer thermometer and AVO meter
Standard personal safety and healthy equipment
Brushes, distilled water, rags.
Standard screwdriver set
Hydrometer thermometer and AVO meter
Work to be Carried Out
Clean dust of battery.
Check that connections are tightened and clean any salt deposits with 
 distilled water.
Check for the correct position of all vent covers.
Check the electrolyte level and add distilled water if necessary.
Rearrangement state: Connect all items which are disconnected.
